n: Warwick RI Masterclass cardboard micro:bit robot car
t: A five-session pack for building and calibrating a cardboard micro:bit robot car.
steps: Find the Teacher pack PDF on the Warwick Masterclass 2021 resource page.
Get cardboard vehicle kits with micro:bits already programmed.
Print the student workbook and the calibration sheet.
Draw a black line track or a town map.
Check the room lighting. The line following sensors are sensitive to it.
Run the calibration step at power on.
Teach the five sessions in order.
